spec.description: News & Articles: save, browse, and deep-dive into articles and news stories. Search the web for articles, save to your Cortex with OpenGraph enrichment, generate AI podcasts, and cross-reference with your entire knowledge base.

tools.label: Browse Articles
tools.description: Browse saved articles with images, authors, and source domains. Filter by topic, search, sort, and paginate.

tools.label: Save Article
tools.description: Search for an article by title, topic, or URL. Fetches OpenGraph metadata (image, author, date) for rich preview before saving.

query.description: Article title, topic, or URL to save

tools.label: Trending News
tools.description: Find trending news articles matching your Cortex interests.

topic.description: Optional topic focus (default: auto from Cortex themes)

tools.label: Enrich Articles
tools.description: Fetch OpenGraph metadata (images, authors, dates) for articles missing enrichment. Backfills existing articles.
